body:
Answering here so we discuss and agree:

> When should we close issues?

When the fix was released (published in npm)

> When should we mark them as "ready for release"?

When done and waiting for a release, actually I renamed it to "✔️ to be released" (+ green) yesterday, to make it obvious.

> When should we mark them as "in progress"?

When you are working on it (those are waffle flow but this mis just github labels)

> Should it be handled through Waffle only or through the GitHub API?

I think it does not matter, I use waffle because its very handy (waffle url: https://waffle.io/algolia/instantsearch.js)

> How often should we do a release?

Right now its really ANYTIME because we are iterating and do not care, so based on needs and the number of waiting for release items.

Once we are really public, then we should more carefuly think about release.

For big features it should be handled differently because we can sync with a blog post etc.

Still even right now for the JS client and helper, we just release as often as we can when it's small bugfixes/features.

> Document (listing all valid words) the format implemented in

Yes, copy pasting the angular commit guidelines with more details should be enough.

Again, open to discussion on this
